description: Ask an SMT solver which variants an element's conditions permit (%configure, experimental): a consistent selection, the check of the selections given, or every consistent selection up to a limit. A part or definition is configured over every assertion about its objects. Read-only: no variant is bound.

all.description: enumerate every consistent selection instead of one. Not with selections

limit.description: with all: at most this many selections

name.description: qualified name of the constraint, requirement, satisfaction, part or definition whose variations are configured

selections.description: variants to fix, written variation=variant; the selection is checked and a conflict named. Not with all

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: configure

status.description: sat, unsat, unknown, unbounded, no-optimum or unavailable (no solver installed, or the element outside the solvable subset)

text.description: the prompt's report: the assignment, the conflicting conditions, the optimum
